snippet.title: 🗡️ Boyfriend Dungeon - Nintendo Switch Announcement Full Trailer 🗡️
snippet.description:
Nintendo Page: https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/boyfriend-dungeon-switch/

Plunder the “dunj” and take your weapons on dates. Capture the hearts of cuties to level them up. Boyfriend Dungeon is the the playful shack-and-slash the world’s been waiting for... now coming to the Nintendo Switch!
